summary: Wrote a 7-phase, 7.5-hour transcription plan for the paper's canonical-frames lemma: 23 declarations appended to FormalSystem/Semantics/Correspondence/DurationFrames.lean covering all four claims, every proof already compiled in the research round's Appendix. Phase 1 lands the two paper-anchor record rows before any citing docstring; Phases 2-5 transcribe claims (a)-(d); Phase 6 is the documentation surface; Phase 7 re-derives a gate-set entry baseline and closes against the full gate set. The plan adds three mechanical obligations the research report missed: a concurrently dispatched sibling has work staged in the shared git index (so every commit must go through git-commit-scoped.sh with explicit pathspecs), the gate set is already red and moving on entry (so closure is subset-of-baseline, not exit 0), and the root README generated inventory block plus typst/generated/status.typ carry whole-tree counts this task's line growth drifts in a sibling's declared territory (a decision gate with a defer-and-record branch).
